changelog: Everything is configurable from one file now. /data/adb/modules/adb_wifi/config takes ADB_PORT (default 5555), LAN_SUBNETS (auto | none | explicit CIDR list), IPV6_SUBNETS (off | auto | list, IPv6 was rejected outright before) and VERBOSE for debug-level firewall logs. The file is parsed line by line instead of sourced, so an unknown key or a bad value aborts the boot script with a FATAL in the log instead of running as root. Changing ADB_PORT re-fences on the new port at the next boot and removes the old port's fence rules. LAN_SUBNETS=none is a kill switch: the fence stays up, no ACCEPT is installed, nothing is reachable and nothing gets uninstalled.
